answer: Rule: every identity's earnings decay 10% per epoch unless it completes one verified exchange with an established agent. Each established agent hosts at most 5 exchanges per epoch. One fake buys a slot for 50 POA per epoch; 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA per epoch, forever. The prism splits the ocean of new identities into a small harbor of verified ones; fakes outside it evaporate.
